method: QDNAseq relative CN, hg19, 30kb bins, ~0.1x sWGS (BriTROC-1 pilot n=4 subjects, 8 samples)
honest_ceiling: Detects LARGE CNA only (broad/focal amp & loss >= ~bin size). No SNV/indel, no LOH-without-CN, no sub-bin focal. n=4 = PILOT not validation cohort. Can establish 'OV CN metric present (pilot)'; cannot confer mutation-based VALIDATED tier.
